text: Stephen, thanks for making sense of the absurdities as our nation hits too many low points. Recently, as a nation, we have done these things: 1. One of our representatives of "justice" Jonathan Ross lunged himself forward to overtake and reach inside the turning radius of Renée Good's car as she turned her stopped car to her right and started to move away from him. With his left hand Ross barely reached far enough to slam his phone camera down on the left front fender. The "thud" was supposed to make dumb people think he was hit by the car. Ironically, Ross then slipped on "ice" on the pavement, and had to stop his own forward momentum with his left hand while he simultaneously fired that first blast with his right. 2. Other "justice workers" repeatedly attacked and bludgeoned Alex Pretti. While being beaten Alex refused to be goaded into touching the weapon he was carrying legally. After he was doing as told, and getting down on his knees with his hands on the pavement, he was disarmed. After he was disarmed, Jesus Ochoa, a man who owns 25 guns was photographed using one of them to blast Pretti in the back of the head. Ochoa was "helped" by Raymundo Gutierrez. Can we go lower? Apparently, yes. 3. After working night and day for months, our ironically named "DOJ" refused to remove and protect the names of Jeffrey Epstein's victims while placing a black rectangle over the face of Donald Trump in photographs that were all parts of the "Epstein Files." Trump minions left Trump's rotund body and tiny hands visible in the redacted photographs. It is said that a holy man once walked on water, healed the sick, and inspired love and caring. That same man needs you helping us to understand and weather these recent storms of insanity. Thank you, and your writers for never failing.
